custom_logic_notes: Bill Williams WiseMan-2 is a custom indicator (part of the Profitunity/Bill Williams system). The EA uses two buffers: buffer 0 for bearish signals (DnValue) and buffer 1 for bullish signals (UpValue). A non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE reading on SignalBar constitutes a signal. When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal is detected on the current SignalBar, the EA scans backward through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal to determine if a close should occur. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory helper functions that handle order execution, position checking, global variable cleanup, and history loading respectively. The updown parameter (default=10) is passed to the custom indicator and likely controls a threshold for signal generation.
python_conversion_notes: The wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python. This is a Bill Williams WiseMan-2 signal (part of the Awesome Oscillator + Fractal-based Profitunity system). The indicator likely identifies when the AO changes from red to green (or vice versa) with specific bar patterns. The 'updown' parameter (10) likely controls a minimum bar count threshold for the signal. Two buffers map to bullish/bearish WiseMan-2 signals. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions need equivalent Python implementations for position sizing (5 margin modes), market order execution with deviation, and position management. The historical backward scan for opposite close signals must be preserved. SignalBar defaults to 1 (previous completed bar), ensuring only confirmed signals trigger trades.
